title: Explosion of a Non-Compliant Supertanker South of the Strait of Hormuz
text:
Explosion of a Non-Compliant Supertanker South of the Strait of Hormuz"

"Public Relations, Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC):"

"🔹 A non-compliant supertanker struck a naval mine south of the Strait of Hormuz, exploded, and caught fire."

"🔹 The supertanker, carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, had turned off all of its radar and navigation systems and, ignoring IRGC Navy warnings, was attempting to exit through an unauthorized southern route in the Strait of Hormuz when it struck a naval mine and exploded."

"🔹 The IRGC Navy states: Owners and crews of vessels in the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman are responsible for any transit through unauthorized routes, and any movement that disregards the security of this strait will be dealt with decisively.
